comment: S2-006 test-only HMAC custody fixtures (spec section 3). These are NOT secrets: production signing keys live in the custody of named subjects (label custodian, annotators, adjudicator) and are never held by the candidate or the verifier operator. The 'forbidden' list documents custody registrations that policy must refuse outright.

keys.note: the keyRef the FROZEN fixture corpus label sets are actually signed with (corpus/s2-006/labels); registered so the custody registry matches the canonical artifacts byte-for-byte (review fix2-E)
frozen-corpus keyRef for annotator b; per-annotator keyRefs with distinct custodians are exactly what the custody-aware comparator enforces

forbidden.reason: candidate/producer custody is self-attestation by construction; registerKey must refuse
the verifier operator must never hold label/adjudication signing keys
